# The Marketing School
> AI ads training plus Google and Meta ads management from an operator with $200M+ in ad spend managed over 20+ years.

## Packages
- AI Ads Training, $297/mo: learn to write, build and audit ads with AI. For anyone running their own ads, at any spend.
- The Marketing School, $997/mo: AI Ads Training plus management of one ad channel. For spend under $5k/mo.
- The Growth Club, $3,000/mo: all-channel management, static creative, custom dashboard, weekly strategy session. For $5k-$30k/mo.
- Full Agency, $15,000/mo + 10% of ad spend: full media buying, creative, dedicated strategist. For $30k+/mo.
- Every management package includes AI Ads Training and a free Ad Account Audit.
